enabled.description: Default for sessions without a per-session override. The /compaction command can override it for one session.

reservePercent.description: Share of the model window kept free. 15 starts compaction at 85% full. Accepts a number or a string such as "15%".

reserveTokens.description: Absolute reserve in tokens. When set, overrides reservePercent.

triggerTokens.description: Exact context size that triggers compaction. When set, overrides the window and reserve calculation.

contextWindow.description: Fixed reference window used for every model. 256000 with a 15% reserve triggers at 217600 tokens. Set null to use each model's reported limit.

fallbackContextWindow.description: Window used when the model does not report one. 256000 with a 15% reserve triggers at 217600 tokens.

debounceMs.description: Minimum time between context checks for one session.

notify.description: Show a toast when Compaction requests a compaction.

debug.description: Log measurements to the OpenCode server log.
